description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It manages the app's main navigation, authentication status, and fragment transitions, serving as the entry point of the application.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages navigation and authentication for the app, handling fragment transactions based on user interactions and login state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the toolbar, navigation buttons, and directs to the appropriate fragment based on authentication status.

methods.name: bindNavViews
methods.description: Binds navigation buttons and the authentication button to their respective views.

methods.name: wireNavigation
methods.description: Sets up click listeners for each navigation button, managing navigation actions and authentication logic.

methods.name: ensureSignedIn
methods.description: Checks user authentication status and navigates to login if not signed in; otherwise executes the provided action.

methods.name: setSelectedNav
methods.description: Updates UI to indicate the selected navigation item.

methods.name: navigateToLogin
methods.description: Navigates to the login fragment and updates the toolbar title.

methods.name: navigateToOverview
methods.description: Navigates to the overview fragment and updates the toolbar title.

methods.name: navigateToList
methods.description: Navigates to a specific list fragment based on the given kind.

methods.name: updateAuthButton
methods.description: Updates the authentication button text based on login state.

methods.name: onSignedIn
methods.description: Callback invoked upon user sign-in, updates UI and navigates to overview.
